title: E2E coverage for TTS lifecycle
description: Add Playwright e2e tests for the new TTS lifecycle after implementation. Tests must run against the local app with test-safe backend behavior and must prove that no real user DB is touched; this project currently has no DB layer, so evidence should state DB host/port/name are not configured and no database client exists.
design: Write scope: frontend/e2e/*, frontend/playwright.config.ts if needed, maybe test harness docs. Do not edit production runtime unless a testability seam is missing and coordinated with main session.
acceptance_criteria: E2E covers: TTS model appears in list; selecting does not load; Start loads; generation only works after load; switching unloads previous; Stop clears runtime state; load error is visible; repeated start same model does not duplicate runtime; state reset/persistence matches architecture; test evidence states no DB env/client is used and no production/dev DB is accessed.

title: Frontend TTS mode UI and API client
description: Add a Text-to-Speech mode to the React UI. The user can select a TTS model without loading it, explicitly press Start model, see diagnostics, stop/unload, enter Russian text, choose voice/options if exposed by model metadata, and generate/play audio only after the model is ready.
design: Write scope: frontend/src/api.ts, frontend/src/App.tsx, frontend/src/styles.css, frontend/src/App.test.tsx, frontend/src/types.ts if useful. Preserve existing S2S call flow while adding TTS mode.
acceptance_criteria: UI has distinct S2S and TTS modes; model selection does not call load; Start model calls explicit load endpoint; Stop unloads; selected model and loaded model are shown separately; switching and starting another model unloads previous runtime; TTS generate is disabled until ready; failed load and unloaded errors are displayed; frontend tests cover the main state transitions.

title: Backend TTS generation API
description: Add backend API for text-to-speech generation through the explicitly loaded/running TTS model. The endpoint must reject generation when the selected model is not loaded, handle model load failures cleanly, persist generated WAV under the existing session/output artifact pattern, and return an audio URL with diagnostics.
design: Write scope: backend/app/main.py, backend/app/adapters/base.py if TTS protocol additions are needed, backend/app/sessions.py if artifact helpers are needed, backend/tests/test_backend.py or new backend tests. Coordinate with lifecycle task contract, do not reintroduce lazy load.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/tts accepts model_id, text, voice/options; it returns turn_id/status/audio_url/text/latency/events/metrics/warnings; it rejects empty text and unloaded/non-TTS models; generated audio is served by a stable GET endpoint; repeated generation on loaded model reuses one runtime; tests cover success, unloaded rejection, invalid model, empty text, and failed runtime.

title: Backend runtime lifecycle and explicit model load API
description: Implement backend runtime lifecycle for explicit model loading. Remove startup/list-model default warmup. Add status model states not_loaded/loading/ready/failed/unloading. Add explicit load/unload/runtime endpoints. Maintain selected-vs-loaded boundary: backend does not know UI selection, and /api/models must not load models. Add adapter unload protocol and cleanup previous runtime before loading a different model.
design: Write scope: backend/app/main.py, backend/app/adapters/base.py, backend/app/adapters/mock_audio.py, backend/app/adapters/qwen_omni_audio.py, backend/tests/test_backend.py. Keep old S2S session/turn contract compatible but require explicit model load before use.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/models never starts warmup; POST /api/models/{id}/load loads only that model; loading another model unloads previous loaded adapter; DELETE /api/models/{id}/load unloads it; GET /api/runtime reports loaded/loading/failed state; create_session/turn endpoints reject unloaded models instead of lazy-loading them; backend tests prove no autoload on startup/list-select and switch unload behavior.

title: TTS catalog schema and Russian Piper adapter entries
description: Extend catalog for Text-to-Speech models and implement an easily extensible TTS adapter surface. Add Russian Piper model entries for small local open-source voices, preferably ru_RU-denis-medium and ru_RU-dmitri-medium, without committing model weights. Add a testable local/synthetic adapter entry only if needed for deterministic automated tests.
design: Write scope: backend/app/catalog.py, backend/app/adapters/*tts*.py, backend/app/adapters/__init__.py, backend/app/models/*.yaml, backend/pyproject.toml if optional deps are needed, backend/tests/*adapter/catalog*. Use local model_path/config_path from manifest and data/models for user-provided files.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog supports text_to_audio/tts capability metadata and voices; Russian TTS model entries appear in /api/models; adapter registry can resolve TTS adapters; Piper adapter loads only on explicit load and reports failed/not_installed if piper runtime or model files are missing; generation path writes WAV for a loaded TTS adapter; tests cover catalog schema and adapter behavior without requiring downloaded model weights.
close_reason: Completed catalog and TTS adapter entries

title: Добавить русский Text-to-Speech режим
description: Цель: добавить режим Text-to-Speech для русского языка в voice-s2s-lab. Модели не загружаются при старте или выборе; загрузка только по явному действию пользователя. Должны быть каталог TTS-моделей, selected vs loaded/running состояние, выгрузка предыдущей модели при запуске другой, явная остановка, диагностика, тестовый ввод текста и аудио-генерация. Research shortlist: Piper ru_RU denis/dmitri CC0 ONNX, Silero ru V5/CIS, RHVoice/Coqui pending review.
design: Keep YAML catalog as source of truth; add task/capability metadata for tts; add explicit load/unload runtime lifecycle; prefer small local open-source models. Recommended initial implementation should avoid committing model weights and should use a mockable TTS adapter path for tests.
acceptance_criteria: Backend and frontend expose a TTS mode; selecting a model does not load it; explicit Start model loads it; starting another model unloads the previous runtime; Stop unloads current runtime; TTS generation works only for a loaded model; errors are visible; Russian model entries are present; tests and docs/GRACE evidence are updated.

title: TTS research notes, GRACE evidence, and docs
description: Document investigation, research shortlist, chosen TTS default approach, model license/distribution constraints, runtime/test evidence, and project docs. There are no existing canonical GRACE files in the current tree, so update README and create only minimal relevant docs under docs/ if needed instead of parallel task lists.
design: Write scope: README.md and docs/* only. Use docs as GRACE-style acceptance/runtime evidence because no existing GRACE artifact was found. Do not create a separate tracker.
acceptance_criteria: Docs list researched models Piper/Silero/RHVoice/Coqui with sources and license risks; recommended default/approach is explained; model weights are not committed; instructions for adding/testing TTS models are clear; verification/evidence section records commands and DB non-use; no markdown TODO/task-list is introduced as a tracker.
